implementation.preferredAsr: Chrome on-device SpeechRecognition; processLocally=true; start(the same authorized live tabCapture audio track)
implementation.fallbackAsr: Pinned Whisper large-v3-turbo FP16/WebGPU incremental snapshots when the local API is absent; selected-video host remains on this path.
implementation.translation: Actual Chrome native Japanese/English to Korean; no cloud/microphone ASR and no companion/Ollama process.
implementation.downloadOwnership: Prepare popup starts install with trusted activation; offscreen joins an ongoing install and observes native pack readiness. Chrome stores speech/translation packs in the browser profile; fallback ONNX/VAD files remain extension Cache Storage.
implementation.overlay: Newest translated tab sentence replaces older visible cues; older corrected captions remain in bounded reference history.
implementation.nativeCaptionRanges: Capture delivery estimates, not native acoustic word timestamps.
implementation.unsupportedNativeLanguage: An exposed local API without the selected language reports preparation failure; it does not use remote speech.

sentenceLatency.method: Installed macOS Kyoko/Samantha voices at rate 180; generated 48 kHz WAVE. Production tab capture -> actual local speech -> native Korean -> actual page shadow DOM. Playback is scheduled 80 ms ahead; end is last input sample with absolute amplitude >=0.00001. DOM checked every 10 ms. Delay is an estimated playback-sample end to DOM text time; physical speaker/DAC and paint timing are not measured. Negative raw values mean anchors were visible before estimated speech end.

intermediateFailures.scope: Fresh SODA download with TranslateKit-only CfT component allowlist
intermediateFailures.result: Two 240-second hidden preparation timeouts; CfT suppresses updates not selected by requiredComponents. The first timeout was initially misattributed to popup lifetime. Adding SODA* permits dynamically registered speech updates while keeping the initial speech pack absent. Final clean download test proves downloadable before Prepare, downloading at popup closure, hidden readiness and actual Korean afterward.

intermediateFailures.scope: Japanese long native final token spacing
intermediateFailures.result: One earlier lifecycle run failed when final whitespace changed sentence splitting. Normalize Japanese token spacing before assigning sentence IDs; subsequent native lifecycle and production flows pass.

An earlier station/time-only check accepted an incomplete meeting phrase; an earlier cancellation check accepted a negative statement before the request ending. Final predicates require meeting intent and a negative instruction.

whisperTurboQ4f16.finding: Quantization still took roughly one second per snapshot and still gave a premature Japanese affirmative at 1.5 seconds; it did not solve sentence latency. Official SHA-verified Q4 files, real WebGPU, no substituted recognition.

moonshineWasm.finding: Actual Japanese SmallStreaming and English MediumStreaming WASM were tested. Japanese output changed tomorrow to あっち and the reservation particle は to が; English sometimes changed let’s meet to must meet. This two-fixture probe is not CER/WER or a general model ranking.
